title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: debugging agent sessions.
summary: The 2026 release wave 1 (runtime 17.0) of AL Language extension adds the ability to debug agent sessions directly from Visual Studio Code. Developers can attach to agent sessions running on cloud sandboxes or on-premise servers using new launch configurations and can inspect what agents are doing by connecting via user security ID or session ID.
key_points: AL Language extension runtime 17.0 introduces debugging support for agent sessions in Business Central
New client type Agent has been added along with two launch configurations for cloud and on-premise debugging
Developers can attach to specific agent sessions using security ID or sessionId parameter
Snapshot debugging stops at the next identified agent session for inspection and monitoring

quotes.text: With this 17.x release it's possible to attach to agent sessions and debug the AL code they are executing.
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the core capability introduced: developers can now actively debug agent code execution, which was not possible before.

quotes.text: You can also use the sessionId parameter to connect to the specific agent session.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the granular control available: developers can target exact agent sessions rather than just the next one encountered.
